title: Headed to ADA 2026?
summary: Visit the Knowledge Portal Network at Exhibition Booth #2324 | NIDDK Scientific Corner!
bodyHtml:
Meet the Knowledge Portal Team and learn about the Common Metabolic Diseases Knowledge Portal (CMDKP.org). The CMDKP is an open-access resource that aims to facilitate the translation of genomic data into actionable knowledge for understanding and treatment of common diseases.

Visit the Knowledge Portal Network at Exhibition Booth #2324 | NIDDK Scientific Corner!

Friday, June 5, 2026Networking Reception6:30 PM–8:30 PM
Saturday, June 6, 2026Exhibit Booth10:00 AM–4:00 PM
Sunday, June 7, 2026Exhibit Booth10:00 AM–4:00 PM
Monday, June 8, 2026Exhibit Booth10:00 AM–2:00 PM

Julie Jurgens will be giving an oral abstract presentation "Human Islet Cell Identity and Organization", scheduled for Friday Jun 5, 2026 from 1:30–1:45 PM (the abstract presentation and publication number is 1031-OR).
